{{Quote|Ah, great. So that blasted bureaucrat Milo finally found someone naive enough to want to free that damn pirate Veem Set.|Bendick|<ref name="Witness" />}}
'''Bendick''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Republic Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Stationed at [[Fort Garnik]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], Bendick received word that [[Milo Phipps]] had hired a spacer to rescue a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] named [[Veem Set]] who was promised to be protected by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in exchange for information that could lead to the end of the [[Separatist War]]. However, Bendick believed a war-criminal like Set would be better off dead and suggested to the spacer that the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] could meet an unfortunate incident instead.<ref name="Witness" />
